bugs.title: Live-smoke capture times out long DONE-required validation and orphans its npm test process group

evidence.symptom: live_smoke_transcript capture returned spawnSync ETIMEDOUT after about 63.5 seconds, persisted exitCode null, orphaned npm test as ppid 1, and left validationLock active.
reproSteps: In TEST run live_smoke_transcript capturing direct lattice done_required_validate for B-c163
Observe capture error spawnSync /bin/sh ETIMEDOUT at the fixed 60-second ceiling
Run ps and runtime_closure_status; observe orphaned npm test process group and active validation lock
evidence.rootCause: live-smoke capture used a hard-coded 60-second spawnSync timeout that was shorter than DONE-required legal budgets; timeout only terminated the direct shell and bypassed nested validator cleanup, leaving descendants and the lock.
evidence.fixEvidence: Commits 65c5580a17 and 2098b0ec91 derive budget only for exact direct DONE-required/done_prepare captures, keep arbitrary captures at 60 seconds with lowering-only override, use a detached process group with TERM-to-KILL reap, and safely recover only classifier-proven stale locks. Focused live-smoke, DONE-required, command catalog/ownership, retired vocabulary, and process-fact contract checks pass.
